About Nike

Nike is the official store for Nike shoes, apparel, and gear for men, women, and kids, including running, training, basketball, and lifestyle styles. This page covers savings strategies for both online and in-store shopping, including where to find markdowns online and which discounts and perks require a Nike Member account.

For order help, contact customer service by chat or call 1-800-806-6453. You can also scroll to the bottom of Nike.com and select Get Help to find quick support articles and order options.

Up to 50% off sale items

Nike’s Sale section is where you’ll find markdowns of up to 50% off on athletic apparel , styles for men, women, and kids. For the deepest discounts, open the Sale drop-down and select Last Chance, since this is where the largest markdowns are grouped.

This section is also where Nike displays limited-time promo codes. When a code is live, you’ll see the offer in green text under the select items it applies to. In May 2026, we saw an Extra 20% off with code offer under select Sale items, including the Nike Air Max 07 Men’s Sneakers and the Nike Swoosh Women’s Sports Bra. Make sure you copy the code and enter it at checkout, since these promo codes do not apply automatically.

Frequently asked questions about Nike

Nike’s free shipping threshold depends on whether you are signed in as a Member or checking out as a guest.

Nike offers free shipping based on your checkout status and order total:

  • Nike Members get free shipping on orders of $50+

  • Guests get free shipping on orders of $75+

How to qualify:

  • Sign in to your Nike account to get the $50+ free shipping threshold

  • Add items to your cart until you meet the minimum for your status

  • Confirm free shipping is applied during checkout

Free option that avoids shipping fees entirely:

Nike also offers in-store pickup. At checkout on Nike.com or the Nike App, select Pick It Up, choose a nearby store, then pick up your order when you receive the ready-for-pickup email. Bring your ID and order confirmation.

Nike does not run a standard refer-a-friend program. Instead, Nike offers a Friends and Family Pass that is sent to select Nike Members.

What the Friends and Family Pass includes:

  • 30% off at Nike and Converse Factory and Clearance stores in the US and Canada

  • Sent to select Members through the Nike App or to the email tied to your Nike Member profile

  • Valid for a limited time, with the expiration date listed on the pass

  • Not transferable

  • Valid only at factory and clearance stores, not all Nike or Converse locations

We tried to pinpoint a guaranteed way to get the pass, and Nike’s official policy is that it is sent only to select Members. Staying signed in to the Nike App and checking your email and account offers is the only way to see it when it appears.

Nike gives Members a 10% birthday discount that activates on your birthday and stays active for around 60 days, with the exact expiration date listed in your birthday offer.

Details to know:

  • One-time use only

  • $100 minimum purchase

  • Applies to the first $500 of a qualifying purchase

  • Redeem online on Nike.com or in the Nike App when you are signed in

  • Redeem in Nike stores by showing the birthday offer in your Nike App profile

  • Combines with free shipping promo codes only

  • Excludes Nike By You, gift cards, select launch and SNKRS products, and Apple products

Nike allows limited coupon stacking. A percent-off promo code can be combined with a free shipping promo code, but two percent-off promo codes cannot be used together in the same order. Two things to note: promo codes are not valid on Nike SNKRS releases, and some products are excluded based on the specific promo code terms.

In June 2025 we applied an extra 20% off Back to School Styles code from this page at checkout and then added a free shipping promo code, and Nike accepted both.

Nike Members can request a price adjustment on items purchased on Nike.com or in the Nike App when an eligible Nike promotion or sale lowers the price within 14 days of purchase. The item must still be in stock online and match exactly, including the same style number, SKU, color, and size.

How to request it:

  • Contact Nike within 14 days of your Nike.com or Nike App purchase

  • Have the product details and the current Nike.com listing available for verification

  • If approved, Nike refunds the price difference to your original payment method

Price adjustments only apply to Nike Member purchases made on Nike.com or in the Nike App, and they are limited to one adjustment per product. To avoid a denied request, do not try it on SNKRS, Nike By You, final sale items, sitewide promos, or anything where the price change is caused by shipping or tax differences.

How to apply a Nike promo code at checkout

  • Add items to your cart

  • Select the shopping bag icon and start checkout

  • On the payment step, find the prompt Do you have a gift card, product voucher, or promo code?

  • Open the code box, enter your promo code, and select Apply

  • If the code is valid, your total updates before you place the order

Promo code not working on Nike? Try this

  • Re-enter the code and remove any extra spaces

  • Confirm the code is still active and has not expired

  • Check for a minimum spend requirement and adjust your cart if needed

  • Check exclusions shown in the offer terms, since Nike By You and select launch or SNKRS items are excluded from many promotions

  • Sign in to your Nike account if the code is member-only

  • If the code box is glitching, try a different browser or clear your cache

10% Nike discount for students, teachers, military & first responders

Shoppers can save 10% at Nike through an eligibility-based discount program available to qualified US students, teachers, medical professionals, first responders, and military members. Verification is completed through SheerID, and approved users receive a single-use Nike promo code that can be applied at checkout.

How to access the Nike 10% discount

To use this offer, shoppers typically go through Nike’s Promotions page and complete a short verification process based on their eligibility category. Nike confirms eligibility through SheerID and issues a one-time 10% discount code once approved.

After verification, the code can be applied when signed in to a Nike Member account on Nike.com or in the Nike App.

Codes generally expire within two weeks, and users may be able to re-verify every seven days to generate a new discount code.

Who can save with this offer

  • US students (high school, college, university, age 16+)

  • Teachers and education staff

  • Medical professionals

  • First responders

  • Active and retired military members

Key terms to know

  • Applies to eligible full-price items up to $500 per order

  • Cannot be combined with other percentage-off Nike promo codes

  • May combine with free shipping promotions where applicable

  • Excludes Nike By You, gift cards, select SNKRS or Launch products, and Apple items

  • Military members may also use the discount in Nike stores with valid ID, subject to store rules

Free Nike membership perks that help you save

Shoppers can save over time by joining the free Nike Membership program. It helps reduce extra costs with benefits like free shipping on eligible orders, easier returns, and access to member-only products. While Nike doesn’t offer a signup coupon code, creating a free account still unlocks ongoing perks that can help lower the overall cost of shopping.

What members get:

  • Free shipping on orders of $50 or more

  • 60-day Wear Test returns if an item is not a fit

  • Receipt-less returns and exchanges in-store or via the Nike App

  • Access to member-only products, exclusive experiences, and Nike sport and style content

How to join:

  • Visit Nike.com and select “Join Us” in the top-right corner

  • Or create an account in the Nike App
